name: Hotel Rauter
beschreibung: The Hotel Rauter is located in the Austrian state of Tirol, surrounded by the mountain landscape of the Alps. It is situated in a rural, quiet area that is suitable for active holidaymakers. The furnishings are modern and comfortable, with a focus on regional elements. In culinary terms, the hotel offers traditional Tiroler dishes and international options. Typical offerings include a wellness area and guided hikes. In winter, guests can use nearby ski areas. The hotel is open year-round and caters to couples and families.
